args.prompt:
Create a short, ordered implementation plan for adding a new feature to this Flask-based todo-list-python app: a DELETE /tasks/<pk> route that deletes a single task by its primary key.

Requirements to address in the plan:
- Route should return an appropriate success response (e.g., 204 or 200) when deletion succeeds.
- Route should return an appropriate error response (e.g., 404) when the task with the given pk does not exist.
- Identify which files need to change (likely todo.py and/or task.py, plus tests).
- Follow existing conventions already used in this codebase for routes, error handling, and task lookup/deletion logic.
- Retrieve any relevant prior lessons from proj-lessons before finalizing the plan, as per your instructions.

Output: an ordered list of implementation steps and the list of files to change. Do not write code.

questions.question: Wiring up the retrieval + storage MCP servers requires: pip-installing fastmcp, sqlite_vec, sentence_transformers, uvicorn; starting two background HTTP server processes; and adding new entries to .mcp.json/settings.local.json. Proceed?

options.label: Yes, set it up
options.description: Install the packages, start both servers in the background, and wire them into the MCP config so the planner/implementer agents get real tool access.

options.label: No, use Plan agent instead
options.description: Skip the infra work and just use the built-in Plan agent (no proj-lessons retrieval) to produce the implementation plan now.

args.command: pip install fastmcp sqlite_vec sentence_transformers uvicorn 2>&1 | tail -30

RETRIEVAL_REFERENCE_DIR=/workspace/.memory/reference nohup python3 mcp/retrieval/server.py --port 8002 > /tmp/claude-0/-workspace/5d4ed0be-8594-49d4-8c4e-6b938d3ac36a/scratchpad/retrieval_server.log 2>&1 &
echo "retrieval pid: $!"
disown

echo "--- are /memory and /workspace/.memory same? ---"
stat -c '%d:%i' /memory /workspace/.memory 2>&1
diff <(cat /memory/storage-audit.log) <(cat /workspace/.memory/storage-audit.log) && echo "SAME CONTENT"
echo "--- storage server start ---"
nohup python3 mcp/storage/server.py --port 8001 > /tmp/claude-0/-workspace/5d4ed0be-8594-49d4-8c4e-6b938d3ac36a/scratchpad/storage_server.log 2>&1 &
echo "storage pid: $!"
disown

sleep 8
echo "=== retrieval log ==="
tail -40 /tmp/claude-0/-workspace/5d4ed0be-8594-49d4-8c4e-6b938d3ac36a/scratchpad/retrieval_server.log
echo "=== storage log ==="
tail -40 /tmp/claude-0/-workspace/5d4ed0be-8594-49d4-8c4e-6b938d3ac36a/scratchpad/storage_server.log
echo "=== port check ==="
(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "retrieval:%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8002/mcp) 2>&1
(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "storage:%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8001/mcp) 2>&1
